verdict.line: You lose if you let Sky Splitter poke you down before level 6 and never close the gap; you win if you land Apprehend from max range and grind Hemorrhage to 5 stacks before he gets a second Frenzied Maul off.

brief.thesis: Volibear's Frenzied Maul only pays off on its second cast on the same target, and his Sky Splitter poke (1200 range, 16s cooldown) is explicitly what wins him this lane according to OP.GG's own data. Darius's structural counter is range: Apprehend pulls from 535, further than Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash, 300) or his W (Frenzied Maul, 325), so Darius wins exchanges he initiates and loses ones Volibear starts from range.

theirWindow.when: E up while approaching across open ground
theirWindow.what: Sky Splitter lands its slow and damage before his Q (Thundering Smash) closes the gap for a stun into a double Frenzied Maul application. Back off until E is on cooldown, or route through minions and terrain to block the bolt.

yourWindow.when: his E (Sky Splitter) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Hook him with E (Apprehend) from its full 535 range before his 300-range Q can reach you, then stack Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) to push Hemorrhage to 5 stacks faster than he can land a second Frenzied Maul for the heal.

start.why: The 48.6% win rate start (73.9% pick) over 2473 games; the lifesteal and AD help you win short trades against his on-hit poke without needing to all-in early.

boots.why: 47.7% win rate over 1695 games; tenacity cuts the lockdown from Thundering Smash's stun and the magic resist eats into his passive's bonus magic damage and Sky Splitter's magic poke.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (58.1% over 129 games); the active haste and armor pen let you stick through his kiting once it completes.
Builds into the same top-winning path; the movement speed stacking closes distance before he can re-angle a Frenzied Maul mark.
Final piece of the 58.1% win rate path; the bleed-out damage conversion keeps you alive through his Q-into-W trade sequence.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest win rate page (46.7% over 25.6% pick share); ramping AD and healing through extended trades matches your goal of grinding Hemorrhage stacks in duels where Volibear's W is also trying to sustain.
runes.note: Master-tier Darius players instead run Stormraider's Surge as keystone across 15,217 games — better suited if you're skirmishing and roaming constantly rather than settling into long 1v1 trades.

summoners.why: Highest win rate combo in the data (48.9% over 29.5% pick); Ignite seals kills off your E-pull all-ins and cuts into the recovery Volibear gets from Frenzied Maul's second-cast heal.

playing.title: Engage from max E range
playing.detail: Apprehend reaches 535, further than his Q (300) or W (325). Pulling first means you dictate the fight instead of eating a Thundering Smash stun.

playing.title: Respect Sky Splitter before level 6
playing.detail: His E has 1200 range and only a 16s cooldown. Don't walk down open lane when it's up; wait it out or break line of sight with minions and terrain.

playing.title: Punish a lone Frenzied Maul mark
playing.detail: W only heals and deals bonus damage on its second cast on the same target. If he's only landed one application, trade in immediately with Q before he can recast it.

playing.title: Time Decimate for stationary targets
playing.detail: Q is a winding swing, not instant. Throw it when he's stunned by his own all-in commitment or caught in his own Sky Splitter slow so the blade, not the handle, connects.

playing.title: Track Hemorrhage for the execute window
playing.detail: Stack bleed to 5 for the enrage AD spike, since Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales off those stacks. Look for this around level 6 and again after Youmuu's completes.

playing.title: Bait Sky Splitter defensively
playing.detail: His shield only triggers if he's standing inside his own E's blast. Holding your trade until he's forced to use it reactively wastes the cooldown without rewarding him.

playing.title: Don't overextend before Youmuu's
playing.detail: Your real spike is the 58.1% win rate Youmuu's Ghostblade core. Before it completes, take short trades off E pulls rather than committing to extended skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
